columns.level: value stored in the Civ VI game setup option
columns.label: name in the setup dropdown
columns.civ_defeat_if_beaten: true: a rival finishing the trigger project first ends your Civ VI game as a loss
columns.rival_lead_modifiers: modifier ids given to every rival that reached space before you (or none)
columns.player_first_modifiers: modifier ids given to you when you reached space first (or none)

rows.label: Relaxed
rows.description: If a rival reaches space first, they start in Stellaris owning the rare star systems made from this map's natural wonders. Nothing else changes.

rows.label: Standard
rows.description: Rivals who reach space before you also start in Stellaris with +15% alloys and +10 naval capacity. Whoever is first owns the rare star systems.

rows.label: Ruthless
rows.description: If a rival reaches space first, you lose this game and there is no Stellaris act. Only the winner of the space race goes to the stars.
